articles.title_en: How do government transfer payments affect retail prices and welfare? Evidence from SNAP
articles.title_cn: 政府转移支付如何影响零售价格和福利？来自SNAP的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the effect of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) on retail prices nationwide. State-level program adjustments motivate our identification strategy. A 1% increase in benefits per population raises grocery prices by a persistent 0.08%. A calibrated partial-equilibrium model implies a marginal benefit dollar raises a recipient’s consumer surplus from groceries by $0.7, producer surplus by $0.5, and lowers each non-SNAP consumer’s surplus by $0.05, because of a large marginal-propensity-to-consume-food out of SNAP, low elasticities of demand, and moderate market power. To guarantee the real intended spending power on food, benefits should be increased by 7%.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了补充营养援助计划（SNAP）对全国零售价格的影响。州级计划的调整激发了我们的识别策略。人均福利增加1%会使食品杂货价格持续上涨0.08%。一个校准的部分均衡模型表明，边际福利美元使受助者的食品杂货消费者剩余增加0.7美元，生产者剩余增加0.5美元，并使每个非SNAP消费者的剩余减少0.05美元，这是因为SNAP中食品的边际消费倾向较大、需求弹性较低以及适度的市场力量。为保证实际预期的食品购买力，福利应增加7%。

articles.title_en: Home or away? Profit shifting with territorial taxation
articles.title_cn: 国内还是国外？属地征税下的利润转移
articles.abstract_en: In 2009, the United Kingdom abolished the taxation of profits earned abroad and introduced a territorial tax system. Under the territorial system, firms have strong incentives to shift profits abroad. Using a difference-in-differences research design, we show that the profitability of UK subsidiaries in low-tax countries increased after the reform compared to subsidiaries of non-UK multinationals in the same countries by an average of 2 percentage points. The shifted profits originate largely in the UK headquarters and its domestic affiliates, not in other high-tax affiliates.
articles.abstract_cn: 在2009年，英国废除了对海外所得利润的征税，并引入了属地税制。在属地税制下，企业有强烈的动机将利润转移到国外。利用双重差分研究设计，我们发现在改革后，英国跨国公司在低税国家的子公司与同一国家内非英国跨国公司的子公司相比，其盈利能力平均提高了2个百分点。转移的利润主要来源于英国总部及其国内附属机构，而非其他高税国家的附属机构。

articles.title_en: Combining rules and discretion in economic development policy: Evidence on the impacts of the California Competes Tax Credit
articles.title_cn: 经济发展政策中规则与自由裁量的结合：加州竞争税收抵免影响的证据
articles.abstract_en: We evaluate the effects of one of a new generation of economic development programs, the California Competes Tax Credit (CCTC), on local job creation. Incorporating perceived best practices from previous initiatives, the CCTC combines explicit eligibility thresholds with some discretion on the part of program officials to select tax credit recipients. The structure and implementation of the program facilitates rigorous evaluation. We exploit detailed data on accepted and rejected applicants to the CCTC, including information on the scoring of applicants with regard to program goals as well as on funding decisions, together with restricted-access American Community Survey (ACS) data on local economic conditions. Using a difference-in-differences approach, we find that each CCTC-incentivized job in a census tract increases the number of individuals working in that tract by close to 3 – a significant local multiplier. Local multipliers are larger for non-manufacturing awards than for manufacturing awards. CCTC awards increase employment among workers across socioeconomic groups and in more- as well as less-advantaged neighborhoods, but have limited impact on residents of affected communities. We validate our empirical strategy and confirm our core results using an alternative dataset and recently developed difference-in-differences methods that correct for potential biases generated by variation in treatment timing and treatment effect heterogeneity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们评估新一代经济发展项目之一——加州竞争税收抵免（CCTC）对当地就业创造的影响。CCTC结合了先前项目的公认最佳实践，将明确的资格门槛与项目官员选择税收抵免接受者的一定自由裁量权相结合。该项目的结构和实施便于进行严格评估。我们利用CCTC接受和拒绝申请者的详细数据，包括申请者在项目目标方面的评分信息以及资金决策信息，并结合限制访问的美国社区调查（ACS）关于当地经济状况的数据。采用双重差分方法，我们发现人口普查区中每个CCTC激励的就业岗位使该区域工作人数增加接近3——这是一个显著的本地乘数效应。非制造业奖励的本地乘数大于制造业奖励。CCTC奖励增加了各社会经济群体工人以及优势与劣势社区的就业，但对受影响社区的居民影响有限。我们使用替代数据集和最近开发的双重差分方法验证了我们的实证策略并确认了核心结果，这些方法纠正了处理时间变化和处理效应异质性可能产生的偏差。

articles.title_en: Violence-induced migration and peer effects in academic performance
articles.title_cn: 暴力引发的迁移与学业表现的同伴效应
articles.abstract_en: We document that local violence generates spillover effects beyond areas where violence takes place, via out-migration from violence-affected areas and peer exposure to violence. In the context of the Mexican war on drugs, we use violence-induced student migration as an exogenous source of variation in peer exposure to violence to estimate its effects on the academic performance of non-moving students in areas not directly affected by violence. Our results show that municipalities that face more violence experience higher rates of student out-migration. In receiving schools in areas not directly affected by violence, adding a new peer who was exposed to local violence to a class of 20 students decreases incumbents’ academic performance by 2 percent of a standard deviation. Negative effects are more pronounced among girls and high-achieving students.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们记录了地方暴力通过暴力影响地区的向外迁移和同伴暴露于暴力，对暴力发生地区以外产生溢出效应。在墨西哥毒品战争的背景下，我们利用暴力引发的学生迁移作为同伴暴露于暴力的外生变异来源，估计其对未直接受暴力影响地区未迁移学生学业表现的影响。我们的结果显示，面临更多暴力的城市学生向外迁移率更高。在未直接受暴力影响地区的接收学校中，在一个由20名学生组成的班级中加入一名曾暴露于地方暴力的新同伴，会使原有学生的学业表现下降标准差的一个2%。负面影响在女生和高成就学生中更为显著。

articles.title_en: When (and why) providers do not respond to changes in reimbursement rates
articles.title_cn: 当（以及为什么）提供者不响应报销率的变化
articles.abstract_en: Policies to reduce health care payments can lead to health care access issues if providers reduce their supply in response to reimbursement rate reductions. We examine the impact of a policy that reduced reimbursement rates by 30% in a workers’ compensation insurance system that provided generous reimbursement rates relative to other payers even after the rate reduction. The results suggest that providers’ supply is inelastic at the part of the reimbursement distribution that we study. Our estimates indicate that the policy reduced annual workers’ compensation medical costs by over $400 million without affecting injured workers’ health care utilization or health.
articles.abstract_cn: 降低医疗支付的政策可能导致医疗可及性问题，如果提供者因报销率降低而减少其供给。我们考察了一项政策的影响，该政策在一个相对于其他支付方即使降低后仍提供慷慨报销率的工人赔偿保险系统中，将报销率降低了30%。结果表明，在我们研究的报销分布部分，提供者的供给是无弹性的。我们的估计表明，该政策将年度工人赔偿医疗费用减少了超过$400百万美元，而没有影响受伤工人的医疗利用或健康。

articles.title_en: Majority choice of taxation and redistribution in a federation
articles.title_cn: 联邦中税收与再分配的多数选择
articles.abstract_en: To study redistribution and taxation in a federation, we provide a model with a central government and multiple local governments, the former with power to levy an income tax for redistribution, and the latter choosing a local income tax, property tax, lump-sum tax or subsidy, and a local public good. Policy is set by majority choice at each tier of government by households that differ by income and by ability to move among local jurisdictions. We provide sufficient conditions for existence of equilibrium and examine its properties. Central findings are federal income distribution, little local redistribution, and local preference for property taxation over income taxation to fund local public goods.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了研究联邦中的再分配与税收，我们构建了一个包含中央政府与多个地方政府的模型，前者有权征收所得税用于再分配，后者则选择地方所得税、财产税、一次性总付税或补贴，以及地方公共品。政策由各级政府中按收入和在不同地方辖区间迁移能力差异的家庭通过多数选择决定。我们给出了均衡存在的充分条件并考察其性质。核心发现是联邦层面的收入分配、地方再分配有限，以及地方倾向于用财产税而非所得税来为地方公共品融资。

articles.title_en: Primary care providers’ influence on opioid use and its adverse consequences
articles.title_cn: 初级保健提供者对阿片类药物使用及其不良后果的影响
articles.abstract_en: Primary care is the most frequently utilized health service and is the source of nearly half of all opioids prescribed in the United States. This paper studies the impact of exposure to high prescribing primary care providers (PCP) on opioid use, opioid use disorder, and mental health. Using electronic health records, we exploit within-facility quasi-random assignment of providers, who differ in their opioid prescribing tendency, to 650,000 new patients enrolling in care with the Veterans Health Administration. We find that assignment to a PCP who prescribes opioids at a 2.54 percentage point (pp) higher rate (equivalent to the average difference between a 90th and 10th percentile prescriber within a facility) increases the probability of long-term opioid use by 20% (or 0.43 pp) and development of opioid use disorder by 4% (or 0.035 pp). Veterans’ mental health deteriorates: the three-year likelihood of a depression diagnosis increases by 1.3% (or 0.31 pp). We find that PCPs with more cautious prescribing behavior rely more on non-opioid pain management and adhere more to clinical recommendations on naloxone distribution.
articles.abstract_cn: 初级保健是最常使用的卫生服务，并且是美国所有阿片类药物处方中近一半的来源。本文研究了接触高处方量的初级保健提供者（PCP）对阿片类药物使用、阿片类药物使用障碍和心理健康的影响。利用电子健康记录，我们利用了设施内提供者的准随机分配，这些提供者在阿片类药物处方倾向上存在差异，涉及650,000名加入退伍军人健康管理局护理的新患者。我们发现，被分配到阿片类药物处方率高出2.54个百分点（pp）的PCP（相当于设施内第90和第10百分位处方者之间的平均差异）会使长期阿片类药物使用的概率增加20%（或0.43 pp），并使阿片类药物使用障碍的发生率增加4%（或0.035 pp）。退伍军人的心理健康状况恶化：三年内抑郁症诊断的可能性增加1.3%（或0.31 pp）。我们发现，处方行为更为谨慎的PCP更依赖于非阿片类疼痛管理，并更遵守关于纳洛酮分配的临床建议。

articles.title_en: Offshore tax evasion and wealth inequality: Evidence from a tax amnesty in the Netherlands
articles.title_cn: 离岸逃税与财富不平等：来自荷兰税收特赦的证据
articles.abstract_en: Exploiting unique datasets covering over 29,000 tax evaders in the Netherlands, we investigate the distribution of tax evasion and its implications for the measurement of wealth inequality. Tax evasion is concentrated at the top of the wealth distribution with over 10% of the wealthiest 0.01% of households – the “super rich” – evading taxes. At the top, households evade around 8% of their true tax liability. The “merely rich” (P90-P99.9) own 67% of hidden wealth, while the “super rich” account for only 7%. Consequently, the correction for offshore wealth has a modest effect on top wealth shares. We describe a number of explanations for the distribution of tax evasion by Dutch households: low-cost tax evasion opportunities in neighbouring countries for the “merely rich”, sophisticated forms of tax evasion for, low effective tax rates on and migration to low tax jurisdictions by the “super rich”. Taken together, these explanations suggest that the distribution of tax evasion strongly depends on a country’s geographical and institutional settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用覆盖荷兰超过29,000名逃税者的独特数据集，我们研究了逃税的分布及其对财富不平等测量的影响。逃税集中在财富分布的顶端，超过10%的最富有的0.01%家庭——即“超级富豪”——在逃税。在顶端，家庭逃避了其真实税负的约8%。“仅富有”群体（P90-P99.9）拥有67%的隐藏财富，而“超级富豪”仅占7%。因此，对离岸财富的修正对顶端财富份额的影响不大。我们描述了荷兰家庭逃税分布的若干解释：邻近国家为“仅富有”群体提供的低成本逃税机会，“超级富豪”采用的复杂逃税形式、较低的有效税率以及向低税收管辖区的迁移。综合来看，这些解释表明逃税的分布强烈依赖于一个国家的地理和制度环境。

articles.title_en: Do environmental markets cause environmental injustice? Evidence from California’s carbon market
articles.title_cn: 环境市场会导致环境不公正吗？来自加利福尼亚碳市场的证据
articles.abstract_en: Market-based environmental policies are widely adopted on the basis of allocative efficiency. However, there is growing concern that market-induced spatial reallocation of pollution could widen existing pollution concentration gaps between disadvantaged and other communities. We examine how this “environmental justice” (EJ) gap changed following the 2013 introduction of California’s carbon market, the world’s second largest and the most subjected to EJ critiques. We estimate that the program lowered GHG, PM2.5, PM10, and NOx emissions by 3–9% annually between 2012–2017 for sample industrial facilities regulated only by the carbon market. Using a pollution dispersal model to characterize resulting spatial changes in pollution concentrations, we find the program caused EJ gaps in PM2.5, PM10, and NOx from these facilities to narrow by 6–10% annually. We demonstrate that explicit modeling of pollution dispersal is critical for detecting these results.
articles.abstract_cn: 基于市场的环境政策因配置效率而被广泛采用。然而，人们日益担心市场引起的污染空间重新分配可能扩大弱势社区与其他社区之间现有的污染集中差距。我们研究了在2013年加利福尼亚碳市场（世界第二大且最受环境正义批评的市场）引入后，这种“环境正义”（EJ）差距如何变化。我们估计，在2012-2017年间，该计划使仅受碳市场监管的样本工业设施的温室气体、PM2.5、PM10和氮氧化物排放每年降低3-9%。使用污染扩散模型来表征由此产生的污染浓度空间变化，我们发现该计划使这些设施的PM2.5、PM10和氮氧化物的环境正义差距每年缩小6-10%。我们证明，明确模拟污染扩散对于检测这些结果至关重要。

articles.title_en: Judicial subversion: The effects of political power on court outcomes
articles.title_cn: 司法颠覆：政治权力对法院判决结果的影响
articles.abstract_en: Are politicians in power treated more leniently in court? We show that Brazilian mayoral candidates charged with misconduct are 65 percent less likely to be convicted if they narrowly win the election. Politicians play no direct role in the judges’ careers, suggesting that formal independence does not completely insulate the judiciary from political influence. The effect is driven by districts with few judges and by judges with higher career instability.
articles.abstract_cn: 掌权的政治家在法庭上是否受到更宽大的对待？我们表明，被指控行为不当的巴西市长候选人，如果以微弱优势赢得选举，被定罪的可能性要低65%。政治家在法官的职业生涯中不直接发挥作用，这表明形式上的独立并不能完全使司法机构免受政治影响。这种效应在法官数量少的地区和职业稳定性较低的法官中更为明显。

articles.title_en: Ordinal rank and the structure of ability peer effects
articles.title_cn: 序数排名与能力同伴效应的结构
articles.abstract_en: Exposure to high-ability peers entails positive learning externalities, but it also decreases students’ academic self-concept because of lower ordinal ability rank. We show that, as a result, the linear-in-means parameter identifies a composite (i.e., reduced form) effect. We illustrate the empirical relevance of this issue using data from two experiments that randomly assign students to groups. We find that the structural effect of mean peer ability estimated by a model that includes rank is much larger than the reduced form effect obtained when rank is omitted. This finding also holds in non-linear and heterogeneous peer effects models and helps clarify the mechanisms behind the effects of ability tracking policies.
articles.abstract_cn: 接触高能力同伴会带来积极的学习外部性，但也会因较低的序数能力排名而降低学生的学业自我概念。我们表明，因此，线性均值参数识别的是一个复合（即简化形式）效应。我们使用两个随机分配学生到小组的实验数据来说明这一问题的实证相关性。我们发现，包含排名的模型所估计的平均同伴能力的结构效应远大于省略排名时获得的简化形式效应。这一发现在非线性和异质性同伴效应模型中也成立，并有助于阐明能力分组政策效应背后的机制。

articles.abstract_en: Roughly one in four juveniles arrested in the U.S. spend time in a detention center prior to their court date. To study the consequences of this practice for youth, we link the universe of individual public school records in Michigan to juvenile and adult criminal justice records. Using a selection-on-observables design, we estimate that juvenile detention leads to a 38% decline in the likelihood of graduating high school and a 27% increase in the likelihood of being arrested as an adult by age 19. Falsification tests suggest the results are not driven by unobserved heterogeneity.
articles.abstract_cn: 在美国，大约每四名被捕青少年中就有一人在开庭日期前在拘留中心度过一段时间。为了研究这种做法对青少年的后果，我们将密歇根州所有公立学校记录与青少年和成人刑事司法记录相关联。利用基于可观测变量的选择设计，我们估计青少年拘留导致高中毕业可能性下降38%，并在19岁前作为成年人被捕的可能性增加27%。证伪测试表明，结果并非由未观测到的异质性驱动。
